subject: literacy
concept: Constructing an original critical interpretation of a literary work and defending it with textual evidence
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student builds an interpretation-evidence chart before writing
exercise.abstract: Student proposes an original critical interpretation of a text and supports it with at least two pieces of textual evidence

assessment.mastery_threshold: interpretation is original (not simply restated from a source) and supported by genuine textual evidence
misconception_flags: states an interpretation without any supporting textual evidence

interest_binding: text generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
